name: questions
description: Two multiple-choice questions on the objective, each with its key

fields.name: stem
fields.description: The question, with maths in LaTeX between $ signs

fields.name: options
fields.description: The four options the learner chooses from

fields.name: correct_option
fields.description: The letter of the one correct option

fields.name: distractors
fields.description: One entry for each of the three wrong options: its letter and the misconception it reveals

fields.name: option
fields.description: The letter of a wrong option

fields.name: misconception_code
fields.description: A short snake_case code for the error that gives this option, such as area_perimeter_confusion

fields.name: difficulty
fields.description: How hard the question is for the class
